description: Autonomous UPSC PYQ analysis for concept discovery, trap pattern identification, and concept pool validation

subject.description: UPSC subject (Geography, Polity, History, Economy, Science, Environment)

years.description: Year range for PYQ analysis (format: YYYY-YYYY or comma-separated)

pyq_file_path.description: Path to extracted PYQ JSON file. If omitted, agent searches for standard location

validation_mode.description: If true, compare findings against existing concept pool and generate validation report

focus_areas.description: Specific concepts to prioritize analysis on (e.g., ['Monsoon', 'ENSO'])

success_criteria: Concepts extracted match ≥90% of manual spot-check
Trap patterns evidenced with question references
Validation report identifies real mismatches (if validation_mode=true)
use_cases: Analyzing new subject/domain for first time
Periodic validation (every 1-2 years) of concept pools against PYQs
Parallel batch analysis of multiple domains simultaneously
Discovering concepts tested in PYQs but missing from pools
Identifying gaps and discrepancies between assumptions and reality
